from numpy import*
T=array([str]*20)
M=array([float]*20)
def module(z):
    p=z.find('+')
    x=""
    y=""
    for i in range (p):
        x+=z[i]
    x=int(x)
    for i in range (p+1,len(z)-1):
        y+=z[i]
    y=int(y)
    w=sqrt(x*x+y*y)
    return w
def Saisie():
    b = 0
    while not(b):
        x=int(input("Donner le nombre des cases: "))
        b = 2 <= x <= 20
    return x
